description: This file contains benchmark tests for various Bloom filter implementations, including setup, performance measurement, and correctness checks. It defines classes for Bloom filters, including an original implementation, a blocked variant, and a benchmark class that runs performance tests on these filters.

classes.name: BloomFilter
classes.description: An internal sealed class implementing a Bloom filter with configurable size and false positive rate, using multiple hash functions and bit array.

classes.name: OriginalBloomFilter
classes.description: A Bloom filter implementation using a fixed-size bit array and multiple hash functions, optimized for space and speed.

methods.name: GlobalSetup
methods.description: Initializes the data structures and sample data for benchmarking.

methods.description: Adds sample elements to the Bloom filter.

methods.name: BloomFilter_Contains
methods.description: Checks for the presence of sample elements in the Bloom filter.

methods.name: BloomFilter_FPR
methods.description: Calculates the false positive rate of the Bloom filter.
